rows.exclusionReason: The antenatal danger-sign screen is the first ANC content this pack will ship. It is deferred only until the pregnancy episode and gestational dating exist, because most of its rows are gestation-scoped and a rule that cannot resolve a gestational age would report unassessed forever. Note the adaptation already identified: WHO's row for a convulsing woman outputs 'clinician's discretion', which is a defensible global hedge and an unacceptable national rule.
rows.title: Before each contact, during the Quick Check, the health worker should check whether the woman has any of the danger signs listed here – if yes, she should be referred to the hospital urgently; if no, the normal contact should be continued as normal

rows.exclusionReason: HEADSS adolescent psychosocial screening. Deferred on safety grounds, not effort: it collects the most sensitive information the platform holds about a minor — sexuality, drug use, abuse, suicidality — and TSHEPO's SPECIALLY_PROTECTED sensitivity class is currently decorative. ResourceSensitivityClassifier cannot return it, it shares a visibility tier with ordinary clinical data, and no caregiver-visibility suppression exists. Collecting this into a record that only looks protected is worse than not collecting it.
rows.revisitCondition: SPECIALLY_PROTECTED produces a distinct visibility tier, caregiver context is a first-class PDP input, and both access and refusal are audited (W8).
rows.title: If client is an adolescent, conduct Home-Eating-Activity-Drugs-Sexuality-Safety-Suicide (HEADSS) assessment

rows.exclusionReason: Health actions on a self-monitored blood-pressure reading. Depends on a series reducer that turns a stream of home readings into derived facts, so no aggregation operator has to be added to the shared predicate evaluator.
rows.title: SMBP.B7.DT SMBP health actions

rows.exclusionReason: Danger signs reported alongside a home blood-pressure reading. WHO publishes this under the same identifier as the health-actions table; we qualify it so both stay visible.
rows.title: SMBP.B7.DT Danger signs
